guide.title: Calibrate {{name}}
guide.step1: Measure how far the first cross is from the top-left corner of the paper. It should be exactly 20 mm.
guide.step2: Enter the difference as the offset X and Y in this printer's settings (a printed cross that is 1 mm too far right needs X −1).
guide.step3: Print the page again and check that the cross is now at 20 mm.
